channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Musk's SpaceX is still restricting Starlink in Ukraine and the toll is rising
item.description: Since last week, Ukraine has reported restrictions on a version of Starshield, a version of SpaceX's Starlink, hampering its military operations against Russia.

item.title: DOJ sues to block Alaska from certifying Senate race winner if Republican narrowly loses
item.description: There are two Dan Sullivans on the ballot in the Senate race in Alaska. The DOJ says that fact could help Democratic nominee Mary Peltola defeat both of them.

item.title: AI's 'Black October': Critical PHP flaws set off global security scramble
item.description: Governments and businesses around the globe are scrambling to contain the fallout after the PHP vulnerabilities leaked online.

item.title: Dow tumbles 500 points as Middle East tensions rise, selling broadens beyond tech: Live updates
item.description: The Dow Industrials fell on Friday as Middle East tensions rose.

item.title: Investors are starting to find opportunities in the battered bond market
item.description: Some market participants see reason for hope in a market bludgeoned this year.

item.title: The S&P 500 is forming a bearish chart pattern. Can it snap out of it?
item.description: The S&P 500 has struggled to break decisively above 7,800 since first reaching that area in late July.

item.title: Qatar deal to buy U.S. natural gas shows how Iran war has redrawn global energy markets
item.description: The Iran war is transforming global energy markets and benefiting U.S. companies, especially liquified natural gas exporters.

item.title: U.S. fines Air France, KLM over flights in prohibited Iraqi airspace
item.description: The Transportation Department said it was fining Air France and KLM $425,000 for operating flights in prohibited Iraqi airspace while code-sharing with Delta.

item.title: Stocks making the biggest moves midday: Chevron, CrowdStrike, American Express, SK Hynix & more
item.description: Here are some of the companies making headlines in midday trading.

item.title: American Express is cutting 5% of its workforce to 'prepare for AI'
item.description: Amex, which reported third-quarter results earlier Friday, is taking a $336 million restructuring charge in the quarter, CEO Stephen Squeri said Friday.

item.title: Democratic socialist set to become D.C. mayor — and face Trump's pushback
item.description: Following Zohran Mamdani's election as New York City mayor, another democratic socialist is set to become mayor of Washington, D.C.

item.title: France is flashing euro crisis signals. This time, the fault lines are different
item.description: French borrowing costs have surged as debt and political risks mount, raising questions over whether the stress could spread across the euro zone.

item.title: Doctors call Moderna, Merck cancer vaccine data a major advancement — despite Wall Street reaction
item.description: Six melanoma specialists said the Moderna and Merck vaccine results represent a clinically meaningful result for melanoma patients who underwent surgery.

item.title: TikTok U.S. hunts for multiple gigawatts of computing capacity, sources tell CNBC
item.description: The operator of the social media platform in the U.S. has sounded out opportunities to obtain capacity over the coming years.

item.title: Fewer people are flying as airfare soars. Here's why airlines aren't worried
item.description: Airlines are reporting fewer people flew in the third quarter as airfare surged on fuel costs, but executives say travelers are mostly swallowing higher fares.

item.title: Why investors are moving back into Treasurys
item.description: U.S. Treasurys are returning to favor as a safe haven play that sidesteps investors' worries over a shaky economy and the future of the data center build-out.

item.title: Texas Senate race: New Talarico ad rips Elon Musk 'dark money' push
item.description: James Talarico hit back at Elon Musk's attacks and spending in a new ad by the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Texas.

item.title: Corruption is voters' top issue ahead of midterm election, CNBC survey shows
item.description: Democrats have worked to contrast economic hardship with President Trump's surging net worth and his family's lucrative business dealings.

item.title: Two ex-FBI officials charged with allegedly lying about Hunter Biden probe: DOJ
item.description: Attorneys for one of the ex-FBI officials slammed the Trump administration for filing the "nonsense charges" just before the midterm election.

item.title: Brent crude oil tops $116, a six-month high, as tensions swell in the Middle East
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump accused Iran on Thursday of trying to manipulate the oil market.

item.title: What we want to see when this data center stock reports earnings next week
item.description: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.

item.title: Now is your last chance to qualify for a Southwest Companion Pass with a credit card bonus
item.description: Southwest is rolling out major changes to how you can earn elite status and its Companion Pass. Apply for a Southwest credit card by Dec. 2, 2026, to help earn the pass.

item.title: Restaurant earnings will test whether owning more brands pays off
item.description: Shares of companies with multiple restaurant brands like Brinker and Darden are outperforming single-chain stocks like McDonald's and Chipotle.

item.title: With earnings in rearview mirror, SpaceX-Tesla merger chatter takes center stage
item.description: A Tesla-SpaceX merger may be in the works, but the companies face a long road of negotiations and regulatory reviews.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield drops back to 5% this week as investors seek cover from AI worries
item.description: The 10-year Treasury yield was just below 5% Friday after AI-driven tech selling sent investors into government bonds.

item.title: College campuses have (largely) gone silent. Can practicing small talk and phone-free spaces change that?
item.description: College students are spending less time socializing, which has implications for later in life and the workplace.

item.title: Russia, Ukraine agree to Oleshky ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump, White House says
item.description: The White House said Friday that first lady Melania Trump secured a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the Russian-controlled city of Oleshky.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine trade fresh strikes despite renewed push for U.S.-brokered peace talks
item.description: Both Putin and Zelenskyy said Thursday they were open for peace negotiations, even as they continued strikes overnight.

item.title: Family offices likely to add risk, debt and alternatives under the next generation
item.description: The next generation of family office leaders is likely to use more debt, invest in more alternatives and focus on different philanthropies, say new studies.

item.title: Trump invokes Cold War-era Defense Production Act for oil production, refining
item.description: President Donald Trump also invoked part of the Cold War-era Defense Production Act, allowing him to provide financial incentives for oil-related activities.
